seo.intro: {name} is a free {category} tool that {what}. It runs entirely in your browser, so there is nothing to install, no account to create, and nothing to upload. Open the page, do the work, and move on. {name} keeps your content on your own device. Whether you need a quick {category} fix or a repeatable step in your workflow, this tool is built to get out of the way.
seo.closing: Everything on this page runs in your browser. Open {name}, add what you need, and take the result with you. There is no setup, no sign-in and nothing to install.
seo.canDoP1: {name} handles the common {category} jobs people run into every day. Paste or add your content, adjust the options you need, and read the result straight away. The controls are kept to the essentials so the tool stays quick even on a phone.
seo.canDoP2: Because this is a {category} utility, the work happens locally. Nothing is sent to a server and nothing is stored, which makes {name} a practical choice when your content is private or you simply value a fast, quiet page.
seo.workflowHeading: How this tool fits your workflow
seo.workflowP1: Most people use {name} in a browser tab alongside the rest of their work. There is no setup step and no learning curve: the {category} action you came for is the one on screen. Copy or download the output and carry on.
seo.workflowP2: If you work across devices, {name} behaves the same everywhere because the whole tool runs in the browser. That makes it easy to return to the same {category} task on a laptop, tablet or phone without changing how you work.
seo.browserP1: A browser {category} tool keeps the useful part, getting the job done, and drops the rest. {name} does not ask for a sign-in, tracking cookies or an upload, so the page stays fast and your material stays yours.
seo.freeA: Yes. {name} is free, with no account and no limits on everyday {category} use. You can open it, use it and leave without paying or signing up for anything.
seo.uploadQ: Does {name} upload or store my content?
seo.uploadA: No. {name} runs in your browser, so your content never reaches a server. There is no upload step and nothing is saved after you close the tab.
seo.installQ: Do I need to install anything to use {name}?
seo.installA: Nothing to install. {name} is a web page, so any modern browser on a computer or phone can run this {category} tool. Just open the page and start.
seo.phoneQ: Can I use {name} on my phone?
seo.phoneA: Yes. {name} is built for small screens as well as large ones, so you can do a quick {category} task one-handed. The result can be copied or downloaded right from the page.

about.title: About Toolpika
about.description: Toolpika is a collection of small utilities that run in your browser.
about.intro: Toolpika is a collection of small utilities. Each does one job, without asking you to sign up.
about.privacyBody: Every tool that touches a file or text processes it inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded, so we never see your content.
about.contactBody: Mail us and a human replies.
about.perkInstantBody: Every tool opens in a tab and works the moment you load it.
about.perkSmallBody: One job per tool, so there is nothing to learn before you begin.
about.believeTitle: Useful tools should stay out of the way.
about.believeBody: No accounts, no uploads and no clutter. Just a quiet collection of utilities that do one job well and leave when you are done.
about.storyTitle: Built for the small jobs, every day.
about.storyBody1: Toolpika started as a set of private utilities for everyday work. Each one solved a single annoyance without asking for a sign-up or sending a file to a server.
about.storyBody2: That idea still drives the site. Tools stay local, pages stay light and the collection grows only when something is genuinely useful.
about.specificBody: Tell us what you need and we will look at it. We read every request.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: What Toolpika does with your data. Which is very little.
privacy.filesBody: Tools that accept files run entirely in your browser using the File and Canvas APIs. File contents are never sent to a server and are never stored.
privacy.dataBody: We do not require an account. We store your theme and language preference in your browser's local storage, which never leaves your device.
privacy.cookiesBody: Toolpika does not set tracking cookies. A single essential cookie may be used to remember your language preference.
privacy.dataList1: Theme and language preferences stay in your browser.
privacy.dataList2: No account is required to use any public tool.
privacy.dataList3: Request submissions are only stored when you choose to send one.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.useBody: Toolpika is provided for personal and commercial work. Keep backups of anything important. You are responsible for the files you process.
terms.liabilityBody: The tools are provided as-is. We are not liable for lost data or outcomes from relying on a tool's output.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms as the site changes. Continued use of Toolpika means you accept the current version.

contact.responseTime: We usually reply within a couple of working days.
contact.toolRequestsBody: Ask for a utility you need.
contact.formNote: Your message goes straight to the admin inbox.
contact.sentMessage: Message sent. We will read it shortly.
